location.site_context: Intersection of Perkins and Richmond roads / southwest corner of Richmond and Jardot roads, near the former Armstrong facility

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11; Google and the City of Stillwater identify the Stillwater campus as under development/site prep, and Google says its Stillwater data center campus is under construction. First service/energization is unknown. Capacity remains unverified; public 700 MW clean-energy and 75 MW large-load-tariff figures are not project IT load.
evidence_grade: B - official city/company/utility sources confirm owner, location, project scale, site-prep/under-construction status, and power-service agreement; local media supports final-plat/building-permit details, but no directly accessible city permit record or energization proof was found.

actions.result_status: City notice scheduled the first public hearing for the Stillwater Data Center Economic Development Project Plan and six supporting incentive districts. The notice describes a multi-phased data center development with private investment of $500 million per phase.
actions.access_caveat: Official hearing notice, not a construction permit or proof of energization.
actions.evidence_note: Project plan/hearing source also gives project-area legal description and 386.698-acre project-area figure.

actions.result_status: City notice scheduled the second public hearing before any vote on the proposed Stillwater Data Center Economic Development Project Plan and incentive districts.
actions.access_caveat: Official hearing notice, not a construction permit or proof of energization.
actions.evidence_note: Retained as government-process milestone for the incentive/project-plan layer.

actions.result_status: City announced Google as the company that acquired land at the intersection of Perkins and Richmond roads for future development of a data center campus.
actions.access_caveat: Official city announcement; confirms owner and land/location, not service date or MW capacity.
actions.evidence_note: Upgrades owner from null to Google.

actions.result_status: Google announced an additional $9 billion Oklahoma investment over two years, supporting development of a new Stillwater data center campus and expansion of the existing Pryor facility.
actions.access_caveat: Official company announcement; not a county/city permit or proof of energization.
actions.evidence_note: Replaces prior public-radio source with Google primary source for the same investment milestone.

actions.result_status: City projects page said Google's Stillwater data center is part of the $9B Oklahoma investment, site prep continues, and construction permits were nearing completion.
actions.access_caveat: Official city project-status page; it says permits were nearing completion but does not provide permit numbers.
actions.evidence_note: Supports local-process/site-prep status but not completed building construction or energized operations.

actions.result_status: Local reporting says the Planning Commission unanimously approved the final plat for the Richmond Road and Highway 177 Addition covering Lots 1, 2, and 7, totaling 202 acres, and that building permits for Lots 1 and 2 had been approved. A CivicClerk agenda page independently lists City Council acceptance of the final plat at 1500 E. Richmond Road.
actions.access_caveat: Local report used for final-plat/building-permit details because the official CivicClerk event page is JavaScript-only in browser fetch; treat permit detail as corroborated but not permit-record primary.

actions.result_status: OG&E announced agreements to power three new Google data centers in Muskogee and Stillwater and said Google will fund 100% of connection costs and contracted costs. The release does not state energization or a live facility.
actions.access_caveat: Utility announcement; it is not a land-use permit, regulator order, building inspection, or proof that load has been energized.
actions.evidence_note: Body/context retained from prior file: OG&E.

actions.result_status: Google said its long-term energy agreement with OG&E will support under-construction data center campuses in Muskogee and Stillwater and that Google is making a long-term financial commitment to pay for infrastructure built to serve its growth.
actions.access_caveat: Official company energy statement; does not prove energization or disclose Stillwater MW capacity.
actions.evidence_note: Supports site work-construction status when read with city project page and local final-plat/building-permit report.

actions.result_status: OG&E data-center page says it filed a proposed large-load tariff with the OCC, expected to apply to new customers with at least 75 MW of demand, and that the OCC review schedule was expected to take about six months.
actions.access_caveat: Utility regulatory-process page; 75 MW is tariff applicability, not confirmed Stillwater facility capacity.
actions.evidence_note: No final OCC approval for the Google ESA/tariff was verified in this refresh.
